description: Suggest sleep times using 90-minute cycles plus 15 minutes to fall asleep. Mode 'wake' takes a wake time and returns the best bedtimes (wake - 15 - cycles x 90 minutes). Mode 'bedtime' takes a bedtime and returns the best wake times (bedtime + 15 + cycles x 90 minutes). Both return options for 6, 5, 4 and 3 cycles. Times are 'HH:MM' 24-hour. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/sleep-calculator/

mode.description: 'wake' to find bedtimes from a wake time, or 'bedtime' to find wake times from a bedtime

time.description: The known time as 'HH:MM' (24-hour): the wake time for mode 'wake', or the bedtime for mode 'bedtime'
